messages:
sarah (sales): quick heads-up 7 Velux POC upload (S3 -> /v1/embeddings) started at ~15:10 UTC and after ~75k rows they started seeing 429s. customer running 12 parallel uploader pods. they want a short-term fix for the demo and clarity on billing impact. cc @nina @oscar

nina (eng): good to know. initial theory: per-tenant token or concurrency bucket exhaustion + burst window. can you grab a failing request_id and approximate timestamps? also, did they use chunked uploads or single-file?

sarah (sales): failing req: req_c9f4a1 (15:32), another req: req_c9f7d2 (15:33). they uploaded via batch of 1k doc chunks.

oscar (eng-sre): saw an alert earlier: "quota-tripped tenant=velux route=/v1/embeddings cap=per_route_concurrency limit=30 observed=46 window=60s". link: https://internal.redwood/alerts/ALRT-9012. placing here for transparency. :warning:

quota-bot: Rate cap hit - tenant velux - route /v1/embeddings - cap_type per_route_concurrency - limit 30 - observed 46

rami (solutions): short-term options: 1) temporarily raise per-route concurrency for demo 2) throttle their uploader (recommend client concurrency=4, batch size=250) 3) recommend Dedicated/reserved for sustained imports. we can offer a paid demo uplift for 2 hours. need sales OK.

oscar (eng-sre): i can apply an override. sample command: `POST /internal/quotas/override {"tenant":"velux","route":"/v1/embeddings","concurrency_limit":90,"burst_window_secs":120,"duration_secs":7200}`. will monitor token buckets and latencies.

sarah (sales): Velux is OK to pay for the demo uplift. please proceed. they also asked "do retries count toward billing?"

nina (eng): yes - each successful ingest call counts tokens billed. retries that re-submit inputs will be billed again unless client-side dedupe/idempotency is used. Recommend they provide an idempotency-key header or use content-hash to avoid duplicate billing.

kevin (security): for the security questionnaire: Velux is asking about data residency, encryption, and who will see the upload logs. i can answer encryption in transit/at rest + KMS. need the tenant canonical name and the support IPs to whitelist. ETA 24h for questionnaire reply.

sarah (sales): sent them the secure form for IP allowlist.

oscar (eng-sre): mitigation steps i'm enacting now: 1) apply 2-hour temp override to 90 concur + extended burst window 120s 2) enable detailed request logging for velux for 30m 3) post-facto scan for duplicate payloads 4) advise client to drop to 4 uploader pods while we watch.

oscar (eng-sre): override payload executed: `override_id=temp-ov-9021` - monitoring dashboards.

quota-bot: Override applied - id=temp-ov-9021 - tenant=velux - new_limit=90 - burst_window=120s - expires_in=7200s

nina (eng): query to find 429s for investigation: ```
SELECT ts, request_id, route, concurrency, status_code, tokens FROM request_logs
WHERE tenant = 'velux' AND route = '/v1/embeddings' AND status_code = 429 AND ts BETWEEN 1729997400 AND 1729999200;
```

rami (solutions): pricing note for sales: short demo uplift = one-off invoice for extra capacity; rough ballpark for reserved capacity at this scale (sustained 40 concurrent embeddings) is ~USD 12k/mo + tokens. i'll prepare official quote after they provide sustained qps and dataset size.

sarah (sales): relaying to Velux: resume the import at reduced concurrency and we'll monitor. please shout if 429s continue after override. scheduling a quick call with Velux in 30m to coordinate.

oscar (eng-sre): monitoring shows error rate dropped after override. will keep elevated logs for 30m and then revert if stable.

quota-bot: Elevated logging enabled for tenant velux for 30m.

sarah (sales): thanks everyone. i'll capture the billing note and send the security questionnaire ETA. follow-up: if they plan repeated large imports recommend we move to Dedicated and we'll prep a migration checklist. :white_check_mark:
__notes: Synthetic Slack thread for presales POC troubleshooting: per-route concurrency, temporary overrides, billing and security coordination. Contains short messages, bot notices, commands, and SQL/log snippets. No title per agents.md.
